reading.ru: Когда Валаам увидел, что Господу угодно благословлять Израиль, то он не пошел искать знамений, как раньше, а повернулся лицом к пустыне.
reading.question: What did Balaam not do this time?
reading.explain: The text says he did not go to seek omens as before.

reading.question: From where did God bring them out?
reading.explain: The text says God brought them out of Egypt.

reading.question: What rises out of Jacob?
reading.explain: The text says a star rises out of Jacob.

reading.ru: Они пожирают вражеские народы, дробят им кости, разят их стрелами.
reading.question: What do they do to enemy nations?
options: Devour them and break their bones
reading.correct: Devour them and break their bones
reading.explain: The text says they devour enemy nations and break their bones.

reading.ru: Валаам собрался и пошел обратно к себе домой, и Валак тоже пошел своей дорогой.
reading.question: What happened at the end?
options: Balaam and Balak each went their own way
reading.correct: Balaam and Balak each went their own way
reading.explain: The text says Balaam returned home and Balak also went his own way.

reading.ru: Валаам увидел Амалика и произнес пророчество «Первым был среди народов Амалик, но в будущем сгинет навек».
reading.question: What did Balaam prophesy about Amalek?
options: He was first among nations but will perish
reading.correct: He was first among nations but will perish
reading.explain: The text says Amalek was first among the nations but will perish in the end.
